site.title: CampusFound
site.tagline: Lost something on campus? Found something?
site.demo_banner: DEMO MODE: this is a preview with fake data. Do not use real information.
site.how_text: Post what you found. The owner answers hidden questions only they can answer. A moderator or the finder decides. Contact details are revealed only after approval.

auth.recovery_codes_warn: These codes are shown only once. After you leave this page they cannot be recovered.
auth.recovery_sent_title: If the account exists, codes were generated.
auth.recovery_sent_text: If the mobile number matches an existing account, codes were generated. We do not confirm whether the account exists.

auth.error.recovery_invalid: That code is invalid or already used.
